# Navigation and URL Preservation Checklist: Standalone pages for doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate the navigation merge rules, address collisions and preservation of existing addresses.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Navigation Merge Rules

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the merge algorithm between page-file entries and fixed Writing, Projects and Contact entries specified (ordering, tie handling, gaps in positions)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is "position" defined as an absolute slot or a relative order, and is its numeric range and type stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the requirement that fixed entries reserve positions stated, so a page file cannot silently collide with them? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the launch labels and positions for Home, Services, Speaking and About listed so "rendered navigation is unchanged" is measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the label default (title) defined consistently with the position being required only when in navigation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the behaviour when a later feature replaces a fixed entry with a page file specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are footer requirements clear that page files cannot affect the footer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the current-page marking rule defined for nested pages and for the home page at `/`? [Coverage, Spec §US1-6]

## Addresses and Collisions

- [ ] CHK009 - Are all existing addresses to preserve enumerated, with expected status for each (six built, three still not-found, cookie-policy not-found)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is trailing-slash behaviour defined for requests without the slash? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are "address already produced by another part of the site" sources enumerated (fixed routes, not-found, future collections)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the reserved status of /writing/, /projects/ and /contact/ against page files stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the link-check requirement defined so the accepted-not-found list is exactly three addresses and shrinks only by editing one place? [Measurability, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is sitemap membership defined for all pages, including drafts, and excluded addresses (not-found, /cookie-policy/)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the canonical address format (trailing slash, host) specified consistently with sharing metadata? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the no-redirect decision for /cookie-policy/ consistent between the spec, the privacy policy content and any external link guidance? [Consistency, Spec §US6-4, §Assumptions]
